children: South Korea’s import prices rose 15.6% year over year in August 2026, easing from an 18.8% increase in July.
Price gains were led by raw materials, which rose 26.6%, while intermediate goods prices increased 16.6%.
Capital goods prices rose 0.7%, and consumer goods prices increased 2.2%.
By economic sector, mining product prices climbed 28.8%, driven by higher prices for coal, crude petroleum and natural gas (29.4%), as well as metallic and non-metallic mineral products (27.1%).
Prices for manufactured goods rose 11.3%, led by a 44.5% increase in coal and petroleum products and a 21.5% rise in basic metal products.
Meanwhile, prices for agricultural, forestry and marine products increased 6.7%, with marine products rising 11.7% and agricultural products up 10.9%.

title: South Korea Import Price Growth Eases
